payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Reducing the AdamW learning rate from 1e-3 to 5e-4 while extending the training horizon to 40 epochs will allow the ResNet-18 to converge more precisely to the validation optimum, reducing the epoch-to-epoch oscillation observed in t0001 (val accuracy fluctuated 0.994-0.996 in epochs 15-20). The lower LR provides smaller gradient steps in the final phase of training, enabling the model to settle into a sharper minimum. With patience increased to 8, the model gets more room to find improvements before early stopping triggers. This should yield a 0.1-0.3% improvement over the 99.59% baseline.
